entries.name: Finder — Documents icon view
entries.visual_locator: Main Finder window illustration; alt begins A Finder window with the Finder sidebar on the left
observed_design_details: Gray sidebar separated from white content; compact icon-plus-text rows under subdued group headings
Documents selected with rounded gray fill and heavier label; blue outlined icon remains visible
Top controls are grouped by navigation, view mode and actions; thumbnails carry most content color
Long file names can elide in the middle; this alone is not evidence of a defect
entries.applicability: Compare resource sidebar selection and grouped command hierarchy; avoid copying file-browser content density
entries.macos_context: Support page metadata identifies macOS 27 Golden Gate; exact screenshot OS build/capture date not observable. Assets can be reused across guide revisions.

entries.name: System Settings — Menu Bar
entries.visual_locator: Main System Settings illustration; Menu Bar selected in sidebar
observed_design_details: Selected sidebar row combines blue fill, white label and icon; unselected categories retain distinct labels/icons
Main pane aligns setting labels left and values/toggles right within quiet rounded groups
Section heading is heavier; descriptive text is secondary; secondary actions use neutral buttons
On/off toggles and checked/unchecked controls are visible together
entries.applicability: Compare parameter inspector grouping, label/value alignment and semantic emphasis; category icon colors are contextual, not a mandate

entries.name: TextEdit — Save sheet and format popup
entries.visual_locator: Convert rich text documents to other formats section; Save As dialog with format popup open
entries.purpose: Form focus, selection and button hierarchy
observed_design_details: Save sheet dims document behind it and aligns labels with editable fields
Name field has a clear blue focus outline and selected text
Open File Format menu marks selected value with checkmark and blue row; alternate option stays neutral
Cancel and Save share approximate visual size; blue fill distinguishes primary Save; checkbox shows persistent selected state
entries.applicability: Compare combo popup selection, keyboard-focus visibility and primary/secondary dialog actions; background document formatting controls are inactive
